visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of dried pink rose petals floating on water in a glass bowl; hands enter to gently swirl the petals. Then, a white handheld beauty device is demonstrated on the back of a hand, followed by a product shot of a gold Darphin cream jar. A woman in a white shirt walks into a bright, white-walled Darphin store interior. (2) Inside the store, the woman sits at a consultation desk with a staff member in a vest. They review a product catalog together in a well-lit studio-like retail environment with soft warm lighting. (3) A series of close-up product demonstrations follow: a yellow cleansing balm is scooped from a jar and massaged onto a hand. A pipette drops yellow oil into the rose petal water, and the woman soaks her hands in the bowl. (4) More treatment steps are shown: essence is poured onto a white cotton pad and wrapped around fingers like a mask. A gold serum with beads is pumped out, and oil from a gold capsule is applied. Hands are massaged thoroughly by another person's hands. (5) The white beauty device is used again on the hand in a close-up. The woman’s hands are then wrapped in white towels. Finally, she holds up several Darphin product gift sets and smiles directly at the camera in a medium shot. The video ends with a logo screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A crisp water splashing SFX occurs at the start, paired with a bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar and piano BGM. The track is energetic and clean with no ambient noise. (2) A synthesized digital 'ding' and a 'whoosh' transition SFX trigger as the beauty device is shown. The BGM remains steady and upbeat throughout the transition. (3) A sequence of rhythmic 'pop' and 'click' SFX accompanies the product shots and balm application, synchronized with the visual cuts. (4) Liquid 'pour' and 'bubble' SFX are used as oil and essence are demonstrated. These effects are loud and sharp, emphasized over the BGM. (5) Mechanical friction and soft 'thud' SFX are heard during the hand massage. The BGM continues until a female voice briefly speaks at the very end with a warm tone.
